title: [v0.92.1][PROV-A] Shared provider inference profiles
body:
## Outcome

Produce one shared provider inference-profile contract with deterministic Ollama materialization.

## Primary deliverable

One shared provider inference-profile contract with deterministic Ollama materialization.

## Verification result

Schema, materialization, invalid-profile, last-known-good, and redaction checks pass.

## Unit boundary

Issue completion is exactly one shared provider-profile contract; provider-specific checks are evidence inputs.

## Dependencies

- None.

## Retained predecessor scope

- None; this is new v0.92.1 work.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Profiles bind provider model and bounded parameters
- [ ] Invalid profiles fail before activation
- [ ] Last-known-good state is retained
- [ ] Credentials prompts and private payloads are excluded

## Owned paths

- `adl/src/provider/**`
- `adl-runtime/src/provider/**`
- `docs/provider/**`
- `docs/milestones/v0.92.1/evidence/provider/prov-a/**`

## PVF lanes

- `profile-schema`
- `ollama-materialization`
- `invalid-profile`
- `last-known-good`
- `redaction`

## Stop conditions

- Tools require incompatible provider configuration
- Private material would enter a profile

## Non-goals

- MLX or Metal provider
- OCI packaging
